title: How to Keep a Betta Fish
summary: Гэртээ бетта загас тэжээхэд юу хэрэгтэй, яаж арчлах тухай.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Gregory Stachel wrote this story for VOA Learning English.

questions.explain: "But how do you take care of a betta fish?" гэж асуугаад сав, ус, хоол зэргийг тайлбарласан.

questions.prompt: How often should you feed your betta fish?
questions.explain: "Feed your fish once to twice a day" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: Why are male bettas usually kept alone?
questions.explain: Эр бетта "aggressive" буюу түрэмгий загас. "male betta fish often attack other fish" гэж бичсэн.
